name: GATE Overflow CS Test Series 2026 | Quantitative Aptitude | Test 1

question.text:
If $x = \sqrt{7\sqrt{7\sqrt{7\dots \infty}}},$ then the value of $\log_{49^{3}} x$ is _________

  1. $\dfrac{1}{7}$
  2. $\dfrac{1}{6}$
  3. $\dfrac{1}{3}$
  4. $6$

If the area of a square is increased $44\%$ percent, what will be the percentage increase in its perimeter?

  1. $5\%$
  2. $8\%$
  3. $20\%$
  4. $22\%$

Given that $a:b = 1:3,b:c = 6:20, c:d = 5:2, d:e = 4:5$, the value of $\dfrac{ed + bc}{cd + ab} = $ ________

  1. $\dfrac{43}{43}$
  2. $\dfrac{50}{43}$
  3. $\dfrac{51}{44}$
  4. $\dfrac{50}{41}$

If the difference between the roots of the equation $x^{2} + ax + 2 = 0$ is less then $\sqrt{56},$ then the set of possible values of $a$ is ________

  1. $(-8,8)$
  2. $(4,\infty)$
  3. $(-\infty, 8)$
  4. $[-4,4]$

Two numbers in the base system $B$ are $201$ and $401.$ The difference of these two numbers in decimal system is $128$. The value of $2424$ in decimal system is ________

  1. $1400$
  2. $1100$
  3. $1300$
  4. $1024$

The polynomial $x^{4} - ax^{3} + bx^{2} - cx + 4$ when divided by $x - 1$ leaves a remainder of $7$ and when divided by $x + 1$ leaves a remainder $9.$ Then $b^{2} = $_____

  1. $25$
  2. $36$ 
  3. $9$
  4. $4$

The value of $\displaystyle \sum_{k = 1} ^{2021} i^k$ is _________

  1. $0$
  2. $i$
  3. $-i$
  4. $1$

It has been found that the number of active COVID-$19$ positive cases in New Delhi doubles every $14$ days. If the current number of hospital beds in New Delhi is $100,000$ and there are $20,000$ active cases, in how many days will New Delhi run out of hospital beds?

  1. $30$
  2. $31$
  3. $32$
  4. $33$

Three partners shared the profit in a business in the ratio $9 : 7 : 5.$ They had partnered for $15$ months, $5$ months and $10$ months respectively. What was the ratio of their investments?
  1. $6:14:5$
  2. $6:42:5$
  3. $8:14:5$
  4. $6:14:15$

Consider the following data on COVID-19 pandemic.
($K$ stand for Thousand, $M$ for Million and $B$ for Billion)

$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|} \hline
\textbf{Country}&\textbf{Positive Cases}&\textbf{Fatality Rate}&\textbf{Population}\\
&&\textbf{(among infected)}&\\
\hline
\text{India} & 310K & 6\%&1.38\;B\\
\hline
\text{UK} & 293K & 15\%&67.8\;M\\
\hline
\text{Spain} & 290K & 10\%&46.7\;M\\
\hline
\text{Italy} & 236K & 14\%&60.4\;M\\
\hline
\text{Iran} & 184K & 5\%&83.9\;M\\
\hline \end{array}$

If the accuracy of the tests and the number of positive cases per million tests are the same, which country would you rather be in if your aim is to survive your life from COVID-19?

  1. India
  2. Iran
  3. Spain
  4. UK

A contractor undertakes to complete a work in $155$ days. He employs $300$ men for $50$ days and they complete half of the work . He then reduces the number of men to $200,$ who work for $40$ days, after which there are $15$ days holidays. How many men must be employed for the remaining period to finish the work?

  1. $140$
  2. $60$
  3. $150$
  4. $200$

The pie chart shows the amount of time each day that Ajay spends on various activities. What is the angle in degrees for the sector of the pie chart representing the time he spends Sleeping (rounded to the nearest integer)?

  1. $112^{\circ}$
  2. $92^{\circ}$
  3. $100^{\circ}$
  4. $31^{\circ}$

The number of common terms in the two sequences: $3, 6, 9, 12,15,18,21,24,\ldots, 1332$ and $4,8,12,16,20,24,\ldots, 1176$ is _________

  1. $111$  
  2. $98$
  3. $92$
  4. $131$

A sector has radius $17\,\text{cm}$ and angle $30^\circ.$ Its area equals _______

  1. $75.66\,\text{cm}^{2}$
  2. $75.42\,\text{cm}^{2}$
  3. $75.96\,\text{cm}^{2}$
  4. $74.62\,\text{cm}^{2}$

The $4^{\text{th}}$ term of a G.P. is $25$ and its $6^{\text{th}}$ term is $64,$ then the common ratio of the G.P. is ________

  1. $\pm \dfrac{8}{5}$
  2. $\dfrac{1}{8}$
  3. $\pm \dfrac{5}{8}$
  4. $\pm \dfrac{64}{25}$

When a two-digit number $N$ is multiplied by the sum of its digits, the product is $144.$ When the number obtained by interchanging the digits of $N$ is multiplied by the sum of the digits, the results is $252.$ The sum of the digits of $N$ is _________

  1. $4$
  2. $6$
  3. $8$
  4. $9$

The value of the $\dfrac{(1 - i)^{2023}}{(1 + i)^{2021}},$ where $i = \sqrt{-1}$ is __________

  1. $2$
  2. $-2i$
  3. $-2$
  4. $2i$

If a person walks at $24\,km/hr$ instead of $20\,km/hr,$ he would have walked $40\,km$ more. What is the actual distance travelled by him?

  1. $50\,km$
  2. $250\,km$
  3. $200\,km$
  4. $100\,km$

One of the factors of $(9^{2k} + 6^{2k}),$ where $k$ is an odd number is _________
 

  1. $117$
  2. $81$
  3. $64$
  4. $36$

A man walking $\left(\dfrac{5}{7}\right)^{\text{th}}$ of his usual speed, is $16$ minutes late. What is the usual time taken in minutes by him to cover the same distance?
  1. $80$
  2. $60$
  3. $40$
  4. $30$

$p,q$ and $r$ are three non-negative integers such that $p+q+r = 22.$ The maximum value of $pq+qr+pr+pqr$ is _______

  1. $>561$ and $\leq 568$
  2. $>449$ and $\leq 552$
  3. $>504$ and $<554$
  4. $>553$ and $\leq 591$

What is Kavya's present age, if after $15$ years her age will be $3$ times her age $3$ years back?

  1. $12$
  2. $24$
  3. $6$
  4. $9$

At $5:40,$ the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock form an angle of ________

  1. $40^{\circ}$
  2. $55^{\circ}$
  3. $80^{\circ}$
  4. $70^{\circ}$

If $x = 3\, \dfrac{1}{3} + 4\, \dfrac{1}{5} + 5\, \dfrac{1}{7} + 7\, \dfrac{1}{2},\,\text{and}\, y = 5\, \dfrac{3}{7} - 4\, \dfrac{1}{5} - 5\, \dfrac{1}{7} - 7\, \dfrac{1}{2},$ then the value of $x + y = $ ________
 

  1. $\dfrac{184}{21}$
  2. $\dfrac{114}{21}$
  3. $\dfrac{174}{21}$
  4. $\dfrac{21}{184}$

If $^{n}C_{2}, ^{n}C_{3}$ and $^{n}C_{4}$ are in A.P., then the possible values of $n$ are ___________

  1. $\dfrac{11 + \sqrt{33}}{2},\dfrac{11 - \sqrt{33}}{2}$
  2. $\dfrac{15 - \sqrt{33}}{2},\dfrac{15 + \sqrt{33}}{2}$
  3. $\dfrac{13 + \sqrt{33}}{2},\dfrac{13 - \sqrt{33}}{2}$
  4. $\dfrac{17 - \sqrt{33}}{2},\dfrac{17 + \sqrt{33}}{2}$

All fifteen members of Indian cricket team planned to share equally the cost of buying a gift for their coach Ravi Shastri. When three of them decided not to contribute, each of the other player had to pay Rs. $5420$ more. The cost of the gift was ₹ ______

What is the remainder when $(49)^{2021 \times 2020!} - 1$ is divided by $7?$
 

  1. $5$
  2. $6$
  3. $1$
  4. $0$
If $N = 6^{11} + 6^{12} + 6^{13} + 6^{14},$ then how many distinct prime factors of $N$ are there?

The probability that it is Monday and a student is absent is $0.05.$ Since there are $4$ school days in week, the probability that it is Monday is $0.25$. What is the probability that a student is absent given that today is Monday?

  1. $16.666\%$
  2. $25\%$
  3. $10\%$
  4. $20\%$
The sum of all the possible integer values of $x$ in the equation $\mid x + 9 \mid + \mid x - 11\mid = 24$ is _______
